config system dns-database
    edit "netops-g20.test"
        set status enable
        set domain "netops-g20.test"
        set type primary
        set view shadow
        set ttl 86400
        set authoritative enable
        unset forwarder
        set forwarder6 ::
        set source-ip 0.0.0.0
        set source-ip6 ::
        set source-ip-interface ''
        set interface-select-method auto
        set vrf-select 0
        unset allow-transfer
        set primary-name "dns"
        set contact "host"
    next
end
